WITH BASE_TBL AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.RECIPI_MNG_NO ORDER BY A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD DESC, A.TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE DESC) AS RNO , A.* FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT B.PIC_INST_NO AS INST_NO , C.TRPR_INFO_NO , C.RECIPI_MNG_NO , D.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD , D.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD , D.RCMDTN_SHELTR_NO , D.RCMDTN_YMD , D.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM , D.MM_PENSN_GIVE_AMT , D.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO , D.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO , D.STTS_OCRN_CS_SE_CD , D.STTS_OCRN_CS_CN , D.PIC_ENFSN_NO , D.PIC_INST_NO , D.PIC_TELNO , D.TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE FROM SEB100 A , SEB150 B , AEB130 C , AEB131 D WHERE A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND A.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO AND C.RECIPI_MNG_NO = D.RECIPI_MNG_NO(+) AND D.DEL_YN(+) = 'N' ) A ) , LAST_TBL AS ( SELECT * FROM BASE_TBL WHERE RNO = 1
AND INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IN ('U01','U04') START WITH INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAB230 WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} UNION SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE 1=1 AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND RGN_CD IN ( SELECT B.RGN_CD FROM SAB230 A , SAA000 B WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' ) ) CONNECT BY UP_INST_NO = PRIOR INST_NO ) UNION SELECT * FROM BASE_TBL WHERE RNO = 1
AND PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IN ('U01','U04') START WITH INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAB230 WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} UNION SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE 1=1 AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND RGN_CD IN ( SELECT B.RGN_CD FROM SAB230 A , SAA000 B WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' ) ) CONNECT BY UP_INST_NO = PRIOR INST_NO ) UNION SELECT * FROM BASE_TBL WHERE RNO = 1
AND PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IN ('U01','U04') START WITH INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAB230 WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} UNION SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE 1=1 AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND RGN_CD IN ( SELECT B.RGN_CD FROM SAB230 A , SAA000 B WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' ) ) CONNECT BY UP_INST_NO = PRIOR INST_NO )
) , FIRST_TBL AS ( SELECT RECIPI_MNG_NO , PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO , PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO , MM_PENSN_GIVE_AMT , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.RECIPI_MNG_NO ORDER BY RNO DESC) AS RRNO , A.* FROM BASE_TBL A ) WHERE RRNO = 1 ) , CHG_TBL AS ( SELECT RECIPI_MNG_NO , PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.RECIPI_MNG_NO ORDER BY RNO) AS RRNO , A.* FROM BASE_TBL A WHERE A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD = '02' ) WHERE RRNO = 1 ) SELECT A.RECIPI_MNG_NO -- 수급자관리번호 , D.TRPR_NM_ENCPT -- 수급자명암호화 , C##RG.DEC_B64(D.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 수급자명 , E.RRNO_ENCPT -- 주민등록번호암호화 , REPLACE(C##RG.DEC_B64(E.RRNO_ENCPT), '-', '') AS RRNO -- 주민등록번호 , D.TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 출생일자 , A.TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO -- 개인식별번호 , A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD -- 수당지급상태구분코드 , CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IN ('03','05','06') OR A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS NOW_PENSN_GIVE_YN -- 현재수당지급여부 , CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IN ('03','05','06') OR A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IS NULL THEN '아니오' ELSE '예' END AS NOW_PENSN_GIVE_YN_NM -- 현재수당지급여부명 , A.RCMDTN_SHELTR_NO -- 추천쉼터번호 , REPLACE(A.RCMDTN_YMD, '-', '') AS RCMDTN_YMD -- 추천일자 , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 F /* 기관 */ WHERE F.INST_NO = A.RCMDTN_SHELTR_NO) AS RCMDTN_SHELTR_NM -- 추천쉼터명 , B.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD -- 수당지급결정일자 , B.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM -- 수당지급결정월 , B.MM_PENSN_GIVE_AMT -- 월수당지급금액 , B.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO -- 수당지급지자체 , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 F /* 기관 */ WHERE F.INST_NO = B.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO) AS PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NM -- 수당지급지자체명 , B.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO -- 이전수당지급지자체 , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 F /* 기관 */ WHERE F.INST_NO = B.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO) AS PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NM -- 이전수당지급지자체명 , CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IN ('03','05','06') THEN ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD ) ELSE '' END AS STTS_SE_NM -- 정지,상실,만료 구분 , CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IN ('03','05','06') THEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD ELSE '' END AS STTS_SE_CD -- 정지,상실,만료 상태코드 , CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IN ('03','05','06') THEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD ELSE '' END AS STTS_SE_YMD -- 정지,상실,만료 일자 , CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD IN ('03','05','06') THEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM ELSE '' END AS PENSN_STTS_MM -- 정지,상실,만료 월 , C.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO AS PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO1 -- 수당지급변경지자체 ,(SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 F /* 기관 */ WHERE F.INST_NO = C.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO) AS PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO1_NM -- 수당지급변경지자체명 , C.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD AS LCGOV_CHG_YMD -- 지자체 변경일자 , C.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM AS CHG_LCGOV_PENSN_GIVE_CHG_MM_FROM -- 변경 지자체 수당지급 시작월 , A.PIC_ENFSN_NO -- 담당자종사자번호 , ( SELECT F.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 F /* 종사자 */ WHERE F.ENFSN_NO = A.PIC_ENFSN_NO ) AS PIC_ENFSN_NM_ENCPT -- 담당자명암호화 , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(F.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 F /* 종사자 */ WHERE F.ENFSN_NO = A.PIC_ENFSN_NO ) AS PIC_ENFSN_NM -- 담당자명 , A.PIC_INST_NO -- 담당자기관번호 , ( SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 F /* 기관 */ WHERE F.INST_NO = A.PIC_INST_NO ) AS PIC_INST_NM -- 담당자기관명 FROM LAST_TBL A , FIRST_TBL B , CHG_TBL C , SEA200 D /* 대상자정보 */ , SCA300 E /* 개인정보 */ WHERE A.RECIPI_MNG_NO = B.RECIPI_MNG_NO AND A.RECIPI_MNG_NO = C.RECIPI_MNG_NO(+) AND A.TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO AND D.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO(+)
